strings.setup.welcome.title: Welcome to DMT
strings.setup.welcome.body: We will configure DMT for this computer. Before installing anything, we will check the network, available ports and the configuration required for secure access.
strings.setup.welcome.nochanges: No changes will be made until the final confirmation.
strings.setup.benefit.simple.title: Simple
strings.setup.benefit.safe.title: Secure
strings.setup.benefit.safe.body: HTTPS with a local CA, configured by DMT.
strings.setup.benefit.fit.title: Made to fit
strings.setup.benefit.fit.body: Ports and access are adapted to your environment.
strings.setup.librarian.caption: Quietly keeping an eye on the machines, so you do not have to.
strings.setup.prototype.next.title: DMT Setup — prototype
strings.setup.prototype.next.body: Administrator and summary are configured. The next implementation step is Installation.
strings.setup.network.title: Network and ports
strings.setup.network.body: DMT reads the TCP listeners already present on this computer. No network scan is performed and no traffic is generated.
strings.setup.network.search: Filter by port, process or service
strings.setup.network.portHint: Enter the HTTPS port DMT should use (1–65535).
strings.setup.network.portInUse: This port is already in use.
strings.setup.network.portInvalid: Enter a valid port from 1 to 65535.
strings.setup.network.empty: No listeners match the current filter.
strings.setup.network.status: {0} listeners found — {1} local, {2} on all interfaces, {3} on a specific address.
strings.setup.network.detected.title: Detected on this computer
strings.setup.network.knowledge.label: DMT information
strings.setup.network.knowledge.disclaimer: The technical data above comes from Windows. This explanation comes from DMT's local knowledge base and never replaces the detected facts.
strings.setup.network.knowledge.rpc.title: Windows Remote Procedure Call (RPC)
strings.setup.network.knowledge.rpc.body: A core Windows communication mechanism used by many system services and applications. TCP 135 is commonly used by the RPC Endpoint Mapper. Its presence is normal on Windows; do not disable it just because it is listening.
strings.setup.network.knowledge.smb.title: Windows file and printer sharing (SMB)
strings.setup.network.knowledge.smb.body: TCP 445 is normally used by SMB for Windows file, printer and administrative sharing. Whether it should be reachable depends on the network and firewall policy.
strings.setup.network.knowledge.lms.title: Intel Local Management Service
strings.setup.network.knowledge.lms.body: LMS is commonly installed with Intel management components and provides local communication with Intel management firmware/features. DMT reports the listener but does not assume that the component is required on this PC.
strings.setup.network.knowledge.rdp.title: Remote Desktop Services
strings.setup.network.knowledge.rdp.body: TCP 3389 is the standard listener for Microsoft Remote Desktop when RDP is enabled. Exposure should match the intended remote-access policy.
strings.setup.network.knowledge.winrm.title: Windows Remote Management
strings.setup.network.knowledge.winrm.body: WinRM provides standards-based remote management for Windows. It commonly uses TCP 5985 for HTTP and 5986 for HTTPS. It should be enabled and exposed only where required.
strings.setup.network.knowledge.dropbox.title: Dropbox local listener
strings.setup.network.knowledge.dropbox.body: This listener belongs to the Dropbox process. DMT can identify the process and its exposure, but does not infer an undocumented purpose for this specific port. A loopback binding is reachable only from this computer.
strings.setup.network.knowledge.unknown.title: No specific explanation yet
strings.setup.network.knowledge.unknown.body: DMT does not have a specific entry for this listener yet. The detected process, service, executable path, publisher and exposure above are still useful facts for identifying it.
strings.setup.access.title: DMT access
strings.setup.access.body: Choose where the DMT dashboard will be reachable. This controls which local network interfaces DMT will listen on.
strings.setup.access.local.title: Only this computer
strings.setup.access.local.body: DMT will be reachable only from this PC.
strings.setup.access.lan.title: Local network
strings.setup.access.lan.body: DMT will be reachable from other devices on the local network.
strings.setup.access.custom.title: Custom
strings.setup.access.custom.body: Choose a specific network interface or address.
strings.setup.access.custom.none: No active network interface is available for custom access.

strings.setup.https.title: Protected connection
strings.setup.https.body: Choose how DMT will protect access to the dashboard. HTTPS remains enabled in both modes.
strings.setup.https.internal.title: DMT-managed local certificate
strings.setup.https.internal.body: DMT will use Caddy to create and manage a certificate through its internal certification authority. No public certificate or Internet connection is required.
strings.setup.https.existing.title: Existing certificate
strings.setup.https.existing.body: Use a certificate already managed by your organization or infrastructure.
strings.setup.https.existing.note: Certificate selection and validation will be implemented before the installation step is enabled.
strings.setup.https.notice: This pilot supports internal HTTPS on localhost. A dedicated local CA is added to this PC during installation; no certificate or trust setting is changed on other computers.
strings.setup.admin.title: Administrator
strings.setup.admin.body: Create the first DMT administrator account. These credentials are used to sign in to the dashboard after installation.
strings.setup.admin.displayNameHint: A friendly name shown in DMT. It does not affect sign-in.
strings.setup.admin.validation.match: The two passwords do not match.
strings.setup.admin.recovery.title: Emergency recovery
strings.setup.admin.recovery.body: A Windows administrator can reset the DMT password from Manage DMT. This restarts the running service and revokes existing sessions.
strings.setup.summary.title: Summary
strings.setup.summary.body: Review the initial DMT configuration before installation. No system changes have been applied yet.
strings.setup.summary.recoveryValue: Local Windows administrator: Manage DMT password reset
strings.setup.install.title: Installation
strings.setup.install.body: DMT is ready to start the privileged installation phase. Windows will ask for administrator authorization once; the elevated helper will then carry out the installation without further UAC prompts.
strings.setup.install.uac.title: One administrator authorization
strings.setup.install.uac.body: The setup wizard stays unelevated. A separate helper requests UAC only when installation begins.
strings.setup.install.foundation.title: Local service and HTTPS
strings.setup.install.foundation.body: Installs the application, its bundled runtime, an automatic Windows service and local HTTPS with Caddy. Windows UAC approval is required. No LAN firewall rule is added.
strings.setup.install.status.foundationComplete: Foundation test completed successfully. No system changes were applied.
strings.setup.install.error.launch: The elevated installation helper could not be started.
strings.setup.install.uac.cancelled: Administrator authorization was cancelled. No system changes were applied.
strings.setup.install.error.cancelled: The installation foundation operation was cancelled.
strings.setup.install.error.communication: Communication with the elevated installation helper failed.
strings.setup.install.error.plan: The installation plan is invalid or could not be read.
strings.setup.install.error.notElevated: The installation helper did not receive administrator privileges.
strings.setup.install.progress.directories: Creating DMT program and data directories…
strings.setup.install.status.coreComplete: The Windows service and local HTTPS endpoint are ready.
strings.setup.complete.title: Installation complete
strings.setup.complete.body: DMT is installed as an automatic Windows service on this PC. Open the dashboard and sign in with the administrator you selected. Use Manage DMT for service controls and report acquisition.
strings.web.title: Inventory overview
strings.web.intro: Explore the latest inventories. Select a computer to view its software and collection history.
strings.web.empty: No results. Check the filters and whether inventory data is available.
strings.web.footer: Read-only inventory · Refresh reloads imported data; it does not run a new collection or import.
strings.web.loadError: Unable to load data. Check that the local DMT service is running, then retry.
strings.web.review.none: No maintenance issues reported in this snapshot.
strings.web.review.remoteUnavailable: No DMT agent is connected for remote updates. No update will be sent.
strings.web.review.rebootPending: The report requests a restart; DMT does not initiate it.
strings.web.review.noRemoteReboot: DMT does not issue a restart. BIOS tools may restart the device autonomously; notify the user first.
strings.web.reportEncodingNotice: Encoding repaired for display; the original report is unchanged.
strings.manage.title: DMT management
strings.manage.local: Local management of the Windows service. Uses Windows administrator privileges.
strings.manage.notInstalled: DMT Windows service is not installed.
strings.manage.wait: Operation in progress. Wait before closing.
strings.manage.source: MT report folder (use a UNC path for network shares)
strings.manage.acquireHelp: Import new JSON and archive verified reports. Quarantine problematic files; delete obsolete variants only after a later report for the same device is verified in the database and archive. Compress closed months.
strings.manage.pathsInvalid: Choose an existing database and an accessible source folder.
strings.manage.partial: Completed with warnings: some files or archives require review.
strings.setup.localPilot: Local pilot: HTTPS on localhost only. The installer trusts a dedicated Caddy local CA on this PC. LAN access and existing certificates are not available in this build.
strings.setup.install.dataRequired: Enter an absolute source folder path, preferably a UNC network path.
strings.setup.install.progress.service: Registering and starting the Windows service...
strings.setup.install.error.operation: Installation failed. Review the details and log below.
strings.auth.title: Sign in to DMT
strings.auth.body: Use the DMT administrator created during installation.
strings.auth.failed: Invalid username, password or session token.
strings.auth.rateLimit: Too many attempts. Wait one minute and try again.
strings.manage.resetBody: Choose a new password of at least 8 characters. The DMT service will restart if it is running; existing sessions will be revoked.
strings.manage.passwordMismatch: Passwords must match and contain at least 8 characters.
strings.manage.passwordReset: Password saved. Start DMT to use the new password.
